title: Manager, GBS - Distributor Logistics
description:
**Job Description**
**Distributor Logistics Manager**
**Job Purpose**
 Leads the Distributor Logistics team for one of the growing region, ensuring smooth Coordination with Business units and Distributors across the regions. Translates demand signals/orders into the B2B to SAP systems to provide visibility on Orders, Volume, Values to Factories/Co packers for production Plans, create transparent visibility for orders/stock availabilities to Business and Distributors and come up with contingency plans to meet Distributor requirements, extend help to supply Planners not only to drives resolution for short\-term supply risks but come up with RCA to avoid risk for the future. This role is also responsible for ensuring the market operating strategies are set and aligned across all S\&OP leads within markets, and serves as the link between the production planning team, BUs \& Distributors to ensure product availability at the right location at the right time to maximize service (CFR \& OTIF). Responsible for the full order cycle, Distributor claims and overall Business Experience. This role will be responsible for driving continuous improvements in processes and take most out of the available tools (ex: SAP,B2B)
   

  

**Essential Functions \& Responsibilities**
* Ensure Distributors Placing orders on B2B portal without any difficulties on time with correct requirements
* Manage full OTC Process and compliance
* Ensure product availability to them as per the agreed timeline to meet service delivery
* Acts as a bridge between production planners, Control tower team, Demand Planning team and Distributors in full filling customer demand and orders
* Supervise Distributor logistics team for one of the Growing region
* Ensure great Customer Experience
* Lead SOD review meetings, Customer Claims Management, NPD/RIRO Management, CS/CL meetings etc.


**Expected Experience \& Required Skills**
* Hard Skills
+ Deep knowledge of Order Management and logistics operations
+ Working knowledge of SAP, Sales force
+ Short\-term risk mitigation, customer centric approach and bias towards Action
+ Data Analysis (Excel, Power BI)
+ QA and Logistics Process Knowledge

* Soft Skills
+ Leadership and team coordination
+ Effective communication with cross\-functional teams
+ Stakeholder management \& Influential (Direct \& Indirect)
+ Problem\-solving \& Risk Management
+ Time Management


 Location(s)
   

  

 Ahmedabad \- Venus Stratum GCC
   

  

**Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes** 
**.**

title: Treasury Cash Management & Banking Operations Specialist - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Treasury Cash Management professional to lead cash accounting, bank reconciliations, payment controls and banking operations within a complex, multi\-entity environment based in Ahmedabad. This role combines treasury operations expertise with digital transformation capabilities to improve financial control, operational efficiency and automation. The successful candidate will work closely with Finance, Technology, Risk, Cyber Security, banking partners and external providers to build scalable, technology\-enabled treasury processes while ensuring accurate accounting, regulatory compliance and strong governance.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Lead Cash Accounting and Reconciliations
   

  

* Own daily and period\-end cash accounting, ensuring transactions are complete, accurate and appropriately recorded in the ERP and relevant sub\-ledgers
* Lead reconciliations across bank statements, payment platforms, collection files, clearing accounts, cash\-in\-transit accounts and the general ledger
* Drive timely resolution of unmatched, duplicated, rejected, returned and aged items with appropriate ownership and supporting documentation
* Establish consistent standards for reconciliation frequency, ageing, review, certification, evidence retention and escalation


 Own Bank Reconciliations and Banking Operations
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end bank reconciliations across bank accounts, entities and currencies
* Ensure bank statements and transaction files are received completely and processed accurately through approved connectivity channels
* Oversee bank account postings, charges, collections, direct debits, payment returns, unidentified receipts and related accounting treatment
* Manage bank account administration, mandates, signatories, access governance and periodic user access reviews
* Collaborate with banks and internal teams to resolve statement, interface, value\-date and transaction discrepancies


 Strengthen Payments, Controls and Financial Close
   

  

* Oversee secure and timely payment processing, including file validation, approvals, release controls and accounting for payment outcomes
* Monitor failed, rejected, duplicate, delayed and returned payments and lead root cause resolution
* Lead month\-end cash and banking close activities, including journal reviews, reconciliation certification, aged\-item reporting and balance sheet commentary
* Maintain robust segregation of duties, maker\-checker processes, access controls, audit trails and control evidence


 Drive FinTech and Digital Transformation
   

  

* Identify and implement automation opportunities across matching, reconciliations, exception management, reporting and bank administration
* Lead implementation and enhancement initiatives across Treasury Management Systems, reconciliation platforms, ERP modules, workflow solutions and payment technologies
* Advance API\-based and host\-to\-host banking connectivity and straight\-through processing where appropriate
* Apply analytics, AI\-assisted matching, anomaly detection and rules\-based automation to improve control effectiveness and reduce manual effort
* Own business requirements, process design, user acceptance testing, deployment readiness and benefit realisation activities for treasury technology initiatives


 Lead People and Stakeholder Relationships
   

  

* Coach, support and develop the Treasury Cash Management team, strengthening accounting, reconciliation, controls and digital capabilities
* Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Controllership, Technology, Cyber Security, Risk, banking partners, FinTech providers and auditors
* Lead governance reviews, communicate risks and issues clearly, and ensure actions are tracked and completed


**Who You Are**
* Typically bring 6 to 12 years of experience in treasury operations, cash and banking, financial operations or shared services environments, including people leadership responsibilities
* Demonstrate experience managing high\-volume cash and bank reconciliations within multi\-entity and/or multi\-currency organisations
* Possess strong knowledge of cash accounting, payment processing, clearing accounts, month\-end close processes, balance sheet controls and reconciliation governance
* Have hands\-on experience with ERP systems, Treasury Management Systems, bank connectivity solutions, reconciliation platforms, workflow tools and automation technologies
* Bring experience in process standardisation, requirements gathering, testing, implementation, change management and benefits realisation
* Exhibit strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, communication and problem\-solving capabilities
* Hold a professional qualification such as CA, CPA, CMA, MBA Finance, CIMA, ACCA or an equivalent qualification


**Preferred Digital And FinTech Capabilities**
* Experience with API\-based or host\-to\-host banking connectivity and straight\-through processing
* Practical exposure to automated matching, workflow automation, rules engines, RPA, AI\-assisted reconciliation or anomaly detection solutions
* Advanced Excel skills and reporting expertise using Power BI, Qlik or comparable analytics tools
* Working knowledge of SQL, data structures, integrations or automation platforms


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to lead treasury cash management operations across a complex multi\-entity environment.Exposure to enterprise Treasury Management Systems, ERP platforms and advanced banking technologies.Ownership of strategic automation and transformation initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and control effectiveness.Collaboration with global stakeholders, financial institutions, auditors and FinTech providers.Opportunity to influence governance, financial controls and process excellence across treasury operations.Leadership experience through coaching and developing high\-performing teams.
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 Treasury technology strategy and digital transformation delivery.Advanced cash and bank reconciliation governance and exception management.Treasury Management Systems, banking integrations and straight\-through processing.AI\-assisted reconciliation, automation frameworks and analytics\-driven decision making.Stakeholder management across Finance, Technology, Risk, Cyber Security and banking partners.Data analysis and reporting using enterprise tools such as Power BI, Qlik and advanced Excel.End\-to\-end treasury controls, governance and audit readiness.
   

  

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
   

  

**Alert**
 Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
   

  

 \#JDEnhancedByTARA

 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/vois/Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/voisglobalInstagram: https://www.instagram.com/voisglobal/

title: Assistant Manager - IT Operations (Technical).
description:
**⚠️ PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING:** 




 To ensure a mutual fit and respect for your time, please only apply if you meet these
 **three non\-negotiable criteria** 
 :
 


1. **Technical depth over title:** 
 You must have 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Windows Server, Firewall configuration (Sophos/Fortinet), and M365\. This is a technical leadership role, not a "desk\-only" management position.
2. **Communication:** 
 You must be able to consult with clients in
 **fluent, professional English.**
3. **Budget Alignment:** 
 Our fixed budget for this Assistant Manager role is
 **₹60,000 to ₹80,000 per month.** 
 If your expectations are significantly higher, this role will likely not be a match for your career stage.
4. If you have applied for any position in the last three months, do not apply again.



  





**Job Title:** 
 Assistant Manager – IT Service Delivery (Technical Lead)
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month (Fixed)
 



**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad
 



  





**About the Role:** 
 We are a growing MSP serving small to mid\-sized businesses (30\-300 users). We are looking for an
 **Assistant Manager** 
 who is a "Technical Powerhouse." You will lead our service delivery team, manage client escalations, and provide technical consulting. We believe management can be learned, but technical depth is a requirement from Day 1\.
 



  





**Who You Are:** 



* **The Problem Solver:** 
 You don't just assign tickets; you know how to solve them when the team gets stuck.
* **The Consultant:** 
 You can sit with a business owner and explain
 *why* 
 they need a specific EDR or Firewall policy in plain, professional English.
* **The Lead:** 
 You are ready to step into a leadership role where you manage people, processes, and high\-level client expectations.



  





**Technical Requirements (The Must\-Haves):** 



* **Windows Server Expert:** 
 Deep experience with AD, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Server environments.
* **Networking \& Security:** 
 Practical experience configuring and managing Firewalls (Sophos/Fortinet), VLANs, and VPNs.
* **Cloud \& Apps:** 
 Proficiency in Microsoft 365 administration and Azure.
* **Endpoint \& Backup:** 
 Hands\-on with EDR/MDR solutions and Acronis, Veeam, NAS (Synology/QNAP).
* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 5 years of core technical experience.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Oversee Helpdesk and NOC operations to ensure 99\.9% uptime.
* Act as the
 **final escalation point** 
 for complex technical issues.
* Conduct technical training and "post\-mortems" (RCA) for the junior team.
* Ensure 100% SLA compliance and identify operational bottlenecks.
* Consult with clients on one\-time projects and infrastructure upgrades.



  





**Candidate Profile:** 



* **Fluent English:** 
 Mandatory for client\-facing consulting and documentation.
* **MSP Background:** 
 Highly preferred (understanding of RMM/PSA tools).
* **Management Interest:** 
 This is an Assistant Manager role—perfect for a Senior Engineer looking to move into management.



  





**Benefits:** 



* Provident Fund
* Paid Time Off / Leave Encashment
* Professional growth into a full Managerial role.
* Opportunity to learn and grow.

title: Branch Head
description:
WE ARE HIRING
 



  





 Branch Head / Academic Head
 



  





 Edugreed Academy – Nikol Branch, Ahmedabad
 



  





 Edugreed Academy is looking for an experienced and dynamic Branch Head / Academic Head to take complete ownership of our Nikol branch.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who has experience working as a Principal, Vice Principal, Academic Coordinator, School Coordinator, Centre Head, or Senior Academic Administrator and understands how to build systems, maintain academic quality, lead teachers, manage students and parents, and ensure smooth day\-to\-day functioning of an educational institution.
 



  





 Position
 



  





 Branch Head / Academic Head
 



  





 Location
 



  





 Nikol, Ahmedabad
 



  





 Working Hours
 



  





 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM
 



  





 Salary
 



  





 ₹30,000 – ₹40,000 per month \+ Growth\-Based Incentives
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. Academic Leadership
 



  





 \* Take complete ownership of the academic functioning of the branch.
 



 \* Develop and implement academic plans for all classes and subjects.
 



 \* Ensure timely completion of syllabus according to the academic calendar.
 



 \* Maintain teaching quality and academic standards.
 



 \* Review lesson plans, teaching methodology, tests and study material.
 



 \* Identify academic gaps and implement corrective actions.
 



 \* Develop systems for continuous academic improvement.
 



  





 2\. Curriculum \& Planning
 



  





 \* Prepare and maintain the annual academic calendar.
 



 \* Plan monthly, weekly and daily academic activities.
 



 \* Coordinate examinations, tests, revisions, PTMs, seminars and academic events.
 



 \* Develop structured plans for board examination preparation.
 



 \* Ensure proper implementation of curriculum across different boards and classes.
 



 \* Coordinate special classes, doubt sessions, remedial classes and revision programs.
 



  





 3\. Faculty Management
 



  





 \* Lead and manage the faculty team.
 



 \* Monitor teacher performance and classroom quality.
 



 \* Conduct regular faculty meetings.
 



 \* Set academic expectations and KPIs for teachers.
 



 \* Identify training requirements and arrange faculty development sessions.
 



 \* Ensure discipline, punctuality and professional conduct among faculty members.
 



 \* Coordinate faculty timetables and workload.
 



  





 4\. Student Performance \& Discipline
 



  





 \* Monitor student academic performance regularly.
 



 \* Identify weak and academically struggling students.
 



 \* Create intervention plans for weak students.
 



 \* Maintain discipline and a positive learning environment.
 



 \* Track attendance, test performance and academic progress.
 



 \* Ensure students receive proper academic support and guidance.
 



  





 5\. Parent Management
 



  





 \* Maintain strong communication with parents.
 



 \* Handle academic and operational parent concerns.
 



 \* Coordinate PTMs and parent feedback systems.
 



 \* Regularly communicate student performance and areas of improvement.
 



 \* Build parent trust through professional and transparent communication.
 



  





 6\. Branch Operations
 



  





 \* Take ownership of the smooth day\-to\-day functioning of the branch.
 



 \* Ensure proper coordination between academics, administration, counselling and management.
 



 \* Maintain branch discipline and operational standards.
 



 \* Ensure classrooms, infrastructure and learning resources are properly maintained.
 



 \* Prepare and implement branch schedules and operating systems.
 



 \* Coordinate admissions\-related academic activities, orientation programs and student onboarding.
 



  





 7\. Events \& Academic Activities
 



  





 \* Plan and execute academic events, seminars, workshops and competitions.
 



 \* Organize orientation programs for students and parents.
 



 \* Plan examination\-related activities and revision programs.
 



 \* Develop an engaging academic environment beyond regular classroom teaching.
 



  





 8\. Quality Control
 



  





 \* Establish and maintain academic quality standards.
 



 \* Conduct regular classroom observations.
 



 \* Review student feedback and parent feedback.
 



 \* Analyse examination results and identify areas requiring improvement.
 



 \* Create systems to ensure consistent quality across batches.
 



 \* Maintain documentation and academic reports.
 



  





 9\. Growth \& Branch Development
 



  





 \* Work closely with the Founder/Management to achieve branch growth objectives.
 



 \* Improve student retention and parent satisfaction.
 



 \* Contribute ideas for new courses, batches and academic initiatives.
 



 \* Support admission and conversion activities from an academic perspective.
 



 \* Take ownership of branch\-level academic growth and performance.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 



  





 We are looking for someone who has:
 



  





 \* Principal / Vice Principal / Academic Coordinator / School Coordinator experience preferred
 



 \* Experience in managing teachers and academic teams.
 



 \* Strong understanding of school/coaching institute academics.
 



 \* Experience in curriculum planning and academic administration.
 



 \* Strong leadership and people\-management skills.
 



 \* Excellent communication and parent\-handling abilities.
 



 \* Ability to create systems and maintain discipline.
 



 \* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
 



 \* Ability to independently manage a branch.
 



 \* A professional, proactive and accountable approach.
 



  





 Preferred Background
 



  





 Candidates with experience as:
 



  





 Principal \| Vice Principal \| Academic Head \| Academic Coordinator \| School Coordinator \| Centre Head \| Senior Academic Administrator
 



  





 will be preferred.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 This is not just an administrative position.
 



  





 We are looking for a person who can become the academic and operational leader of the Nikol branch.
 



  





 The right candidate should be able to walk into the branch and ask:
 



  





 “What is happening academically?
 



 Are teachers performing well?
 



 Are students learning properly?
 



 Are parents satisfied?
 



 Is the academic calendar on track?
 



 Where are the weak students?
 



 What needs to improve?
 



 What systems can make this branch better?”
 



  





 You will be expected to build systems, lead people, maintain quality and take ownership of results.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 COMPENSATION
 



  





 ₹30,000 – ₹40,000/month
 



  





 \* Performance/Growth\-Based Incentives
 



  





 Additional incentives will be linked to measurable branch growth and performance.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 WHY JOIN EDUGREED?
 



  





 \* Leadership role with significant autonomy.
 



 \* Opportunity to build and improve an education centre.
 



 \* Direct interaction with the Founder/Management.
 



 \* Opportunity to create academic systems and processes.
 



 \* Performance\-based growth and incentives.
 



 \* Opportunity to become a key part of Edugreed’s expansion journey.
 



  





 Apply Now
 



  





 Location: Edugreed Academy, Nikol, Ahmedabad
 



  





 Contact: \[Add Contact Number]
 



  





 Apply Here: \[Add Application Form Link]

title: Contract Manager
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL)** 
 : AGEL is part of the Adani Group’s promise to provide a better, cleaner, and greener future for India. Driven by the Group’s philosophy of Growth with Goodness’, the Company develops, builds, owns, operates, and maintains utility\- scale grid\-connected solar, wind farm and energy storage (Hydro PSP and Battery) projects. The electricity generated is supplied to central and state government entities and government\- backed corporations. On the back of long\-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with central and state government entities, AGEL has leveraged its capabilities and expanded its presence across 12 Indian states. With the integration of pump storage and battery storage projects with large solar \& wind portfolio, AGEL shall be best placed amongst peers to supply round\-the\-clock green power to India’s grid. The Company continuously adopts and deploys the latest technologies in its projects. With the target of 50 GW renewable energy capacity by 2030, AGEL is driving India on its renewable energy journey.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Regional Security Head is responsible for fostering a culture of security awareness and operational excellence across assigned geographic regions. This role entails overseeing all security functions at individual sites and clusters, ensuring compliance with security protocols and regulations. By driving strategic initiatives, mentoring security personnel, and enhancing stakeholder collaboration, the Regional Security Head aims to safeguard organizational assets, mitigate risks, and ensure business continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Team Support and Coordination:**
 Assist in setting team goals by gathering input from team members and ensuring that assigned tasks align with individual expertise and project requirements.
   

  

 Facilitate smooth collaboration by coordinating schedules, following up on action items, and ensuring effective communication between departments as directed by the lead.
   

  

**Vendor Management**
 Support in compiling necessary data, preparing initial drafts of contracts, and ensuring that vendor proposals meet basic project requirements before presenting them to the lead.
   

  

 Help maintain vendor relationships by tracking contract timelines, monitoring vendor performance, and escalating any issues to the lead for resolution.
   

  

**Ensuring Regulatory And Safety Compliance**
 Monitor adherence to contract terms by tracking deadlines, budget limits, and quality standards, reporting deviations to the lead for further action.
   

  

 Coordinate with legal, finance, and procurement teams to ensure updates or amendments to contracts are implemented efficiently under the lead’s guidance.

description:

With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

 Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India.We have a power generation capacity of 15,250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 This role is responsible for managing billing processes, revenue, and payment collection by ensuring accurate and timely updates on various portals, responds to disputes, and provides detailed financial reporting.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Associate Manager \- Regulatory \& Commercial (ERCG)**
**Billing And Revenue Management**
 Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.
   

  

 Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

 Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers
   

  

 Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.
   

  

 Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.
   

  

 Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.
   

  

 Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.
   

  

**Payment Tracking And Dispute Resolution**
 Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.
   

  

 In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.
   

  

 Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.
   

  

 Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.
   

  

 Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.
   

  

**Portal Management**
 Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.
   

  

 Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.
   

  

 Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.
   

  

 Enforce restrictions on short\-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.
   

  

 Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.
   

  

**Financial Reporting And Reconciliation**
 Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.
   

  

 Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.
   

  

 Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.
   

  

**Regulatory Support And Tariff Management**
 Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.
   

  

 Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.
   

  

 In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.

title: Manager, Internal Audit
description:
**Job Description**
**SOX 404 Compliance, Control Design and Testing (approximately 60–70%)**
 Plan and execute assigned activities within the Company’s SOX 404 compliance program, ensuring work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with internal methodology and external\-auditor expectations.
   

  

* Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs): Maintain and update RCMs for relevant business processes and IT applications. Confirm that risks are appropriately addressed, control descriptions are clear and complete, and changes in processes, systems, ownership, or risk are reflected promptly.
* Walkthroughs and scoping: Conduct process and control walkthroughs, assess annual scope and key\-control coverage, document process flows, and identify changes that may affect control design or testing strategy.
* Business\-process controls: Evaluate the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of controls across key cycles, including Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Financial Close and Consolidation, Human Resources and Payroll, Property, Plant and Equipment, Treasury, Inventory, and other in\-scope processes.
* IT application controls (ITACs): Identify and test automated and semi\-automated controls within enterprise applications, including automated calculations, workflow approvals, three\-way matching, system configurations, and interfaces between internal systems and external service providers.
* Key reports and information produced by the entity (IPE): Identify reports, queries, spreadsheets, and other information used in control performance. Test completeness and accuracy through report logic, parameters, configuration, source\-to\-output reconciliation, access, change management, and, where applicable, SQL or code review.
* Testing and documentation: Prepare clear, complete, and reproducible workpapers that document procedures performed, evidence examined, samples selected, conclusions reached, and reviewer follow\-up. Record testing results and findings in the designated audit and SOX management system.
* Deficiency evaluation and remediation: Identify control gaps, perform root\-cause analysis with stakeholders, assess deficiency severity in accordance with the Company’s framework, agree practical remediation actions, monitor milestones, and retest completed remediation.
* External\-auditor coordination: Act as a primary point of coordination for assigned SOX areas, facilitate walkthroughs and evidence requests, resolve questions, and maintain alignment on scope, testing status, deficiencies, and remediation.
* Control\-owner training: Provide onboarding and periodic refresher training to control owners and performers on control objectives, evidence standards, documentation requirements, and changes to the SOX program.


**Business\-Process Audits, Systems and Advisory (approximately 30–40%)**
* Business\-process and operational audits: Support risk assessments, develop audit programs, perform interviews and testing, analyze root causes and business impact, and prepare practical recommendations. Assignments may cover financial, operational, compliance, technology\-enabled, and cross\-functional processes.
* Audit reporting and communication: Prepare concise status updates, findings, risk statements, and recommendations for management reports and presentations. Maintain regular communication with process owners, Internal Audit leadership, IT, and external auditors; escalate significant issues or delays promptly.
* Issue follow\-up: Maintain accurate records of open actions, validate remediation evidence, confirm sustainable closure, and report overdue or unresolved matters to appropriate stakeholders.
* Control advisory and continuous improvement: Advise stakeholders on process and control improvements while preserving Internal Audit independence. Promote standardized, efficient, and sustainable controls that comply with Company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Data analytics: Use data analysis to identify unusual transactions, process exceptions, control failures, operational bottlenecks, and indicators of error or potential fraud.
* Use of AI: Use Company\-approved AI and audit\-automation tools to support audit planning, SOX control testing, evidence analysis, workpaper preparation, and identification of control gaps. Validate all AI\-generated outputs against source evidence, apply professional judgment and human oversight, and comply with the Company’s confidentiality, data\-privacy, information\-security, and responsible\-AI requirements.
* Other assignments: Support investigations, inventory cycle counts, year\-end physical counts, and other Internal Audit priorities as assigned. Travel to Company locations is required.

* Master Degree (MS/MA) ICWA \- Preferred
* Master Degree (MBA) MBA \- Preferred

* 12 years or more in 12 \- 15 Years

 \* Control inward and outward movement of workshop materials.
 



 \* Maintain proper stock of raw materials, components, WIP and finished goods.
 



 \* Ensure every material movement is documented.
 



 \* Coordinate with Purchase and Stores departments.
 



 \* Conduct regular physical stock verification.
 



 \* Identify excess, shortage, slow\-moving and damaged inventory.
 



  





 E. Manpower Management
 



  





 \* Allocate work to workers according to skill and workload.
 



 \* Monitor attendance, discipline and productivity.
 



 \* Identify manpower requirements.
 



 \* Train and guide workers wherever required.
 



 \* Ensure proper utilization of manpower.
 



 \* Report performance issues to management.
 



  





 F. Quality Control
 



  





 \* Ensure products are manufactured according to approved specifications.
 



 \* Establish inspection/checking points during production.
 



 \* Reduce rejection, rework and customer complaints.
 



 \* Identify root causes of recurring production problems.
 



 \* Maintain quality\-related records.
 



  





 G. Maintenance \& Safety
 



  





 \* Ensure machines, tools and equipment are properly maintained.
 



 \* Prepare preventive maintenance schedules.
 



 \* Immediately report machine breakdowns and major maintenance requirements.
 



 \* Maintain workshop safety standards.
 



 \* Ensure workers use appropriate safety equipment and follow safety procedures.
 



  





 H. ERP / MIS \& Reporting
 



 The manager must ensure that all workshop activities are properly recorded in the ERP system.
 



  





 Daily reports should include:
 



  





 \* Production completed
 



 \* Pending production
 



 \* Material consumption
 



 \* WIP
 



 \* Job work status
 



 \* Dispatch status
 



 \* Manpower utilization
 



 \* Machine breakdown
 



 \* Rejection / rework
 



 \* Inventory shortage/excess
 



  





 3\. Daily Responsibilities
 



  





 \* Conduct morning workshop meeting.
 



 \* Review pending orders and production priorities.
 



 \* Allocate manpower.
 



 \* Check material availability.
 



 \* Review production progress during the day.
 



 \* Follow up on outside job work.
 



 \* Check quality and quantity.
 



 \* Review dispatch requirements.
 



 \* Submit end\-of\-day production report to management.
 



  





 4\. Weekly Responsibilities
 



  





 \* Prepare weekly production plan.
 



 \* Review production efficiency.
 



 \* Review job\-work performance.
 



 \* Review inventory and material consumption.
 



 \* Review machine maintenance.
 



 \* Review manpower productivity.
 



 \* Identify major problems and submit corrective\-action plan.
 



  





 5\. Candidate Profile
 



  





 Education:
 



  





 \* Diploma / B.E. Mechanical preferred
 



 \* Production / Manufacturing background preferred
 



 \* ITI \+ strong practical experience can also be considered
 



  





 Experience:
 



  





 \* 5–10 years in manufacturing / workshop / production operations
 



 \* Experience in fabrication, assembly, MS components or plastic components preferred
 



 \* Experience handling outside job work is highly desirable
 



 \* ERP knowledge is an advantage
 



  





 6\. Required Skills
 



  





 Candidate should have strong knowledge of:
 



  





 \* Production planning
 



 \* Workshop management
 



 \* MS fabrication
 



 \* Manufacturing processes
 



 \* Assembly
 



 \* Plastic component manufacturing
 



 \* Inventory control
 



 \* Job\-work management
 



 \* Quality control
 



 \* Manpower management
 



 \* Cost and wastage control
 



 \* ERP / Excel / MIS
 



 \* Basic drawing and measurement understanding
 



 \* Machine and tool management
 



  





 7\. Important Management Qualities
 



  





 The person should be:
 



  





 \* Responsible and accountable
 



 \* Strong in team management
 



 \* Practical and technically sound
 



 \* Disciplined
 



 \* Good at problem\-solving
 



 \* Able to control workers and job workers
 



 \* Strong in follow\-up
 



 \* Data/report oriented
 



 \* Honest and transparent
 



 \* Capable of working independently without constant supervision
 



  





 8\. KPIs – Performance Measurement
 



  





 The Workshop Manager will be measured on:
 



  





 1\. Production target achievement
 



 2\. On\-time completion of orders
 



 3\. Reduction in rejection/rework
 



 4\. Material wastage percentage
 



 5\. Inventory accuracy
 



 6\. Job\-work delivery performance
 



 7\. Manpower productivity
 



 8\. Machine utilization
 



 9\. Breakdown reduction
 



 10\. Cost control
 



 11\. ERP/reporting accuracy
 



 12\. Workplace discipline and safety
 



  





 9\. Authority \& Accountability
 



  





 The Workshop Manager will be responsible for:
 



  





 Manpower → Material → Machine → Production → Job Work → Quality → Inventory → Dispatch → Reporting
 



  





 Any shortage, wastage, delay, quality issue or unexplained inventory difference must be immediately reported to management with the reason and corrective action.
 



  





 10\. Preferred Structure
 



  





 Director / Owner
 



 ↓
 



 Workshop \& Operations Manager
 



 ↓
 



 Production / Fabrication / Assembly Supervisors
 



 ↓
 



 Workers / Technicians
 



  





 Coordination with:
 


* Purchase \| Sales \| Accounts \| Stores \| External Job Workers

title: DGM - Production Pilot line
description:
Purpose of the Role
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end process management of the entire Pilot Line, including planning and execution of chemistry changeovers (e.g., LFP to NMC, or any other emerging chemistry) to support R\&D trials and new product qualification. Organize and control Pilot Line operations across all process areas E/A/B zones to support process qualification, DOE trials, and yield/quality improvement targets across chemistries.
   

  

 Key Responsibility Areas
   

  

 Manpower, Line \& Shop\-floor Management
   

  

* Plan and manage manpower deployment across the Pilot Line including shift/line management, attendance, multi\-skilling, and readiness for changeover\-driven workload swings.
* Own overall shop\-floor management of the Pilot Line, day\-to\-day activities across process areas, work allocation, housekeeping (5S), and coordination across electrode, cutting/stacking, cell assembly, welding, formation \& aging, and inspection stations.
* Manage non\-standard procurement and consumables required for pilot builds (trial materials, spares, tooling, jigs/fixtures, chemistry\-specific PPE), coordinating with Procurement/Stores to avoid trial downtime.


 Knowledge Generic
   

  

 Process Ownership \& Chemistry Changeover Management
   

  

* Own the Pilot Line process end\-to\-end across all process areas, including planning, sequencing, and executing changeovers between chemistries (e.g., LFP to NMC or other future chemistries) with minimal downtime.
* Define and maintain changeover procedures, process parameters, and equipment settings/fixtures required for each chemistry, ensuring the line can be reconfigured quickly and repeatably for new trials.


 Job Context
   

  

 Functional
   

  

* Organize and implement Pilot Line process/changeover strategies and action plans across all process areas to attain process\-validation and productivity targets across chemistries.
* Capture, analyze, and report trial data (process capability, NG rates, root\-cause analysis) to support go/no\-go decisions on process and equipment readiness for mass production.
* Initiate plans and processes which minimize Pilot Line costs through effective utilization of manpower, equipment, facilities, materials, energy, and trial\-cell capital across changeovers.


 Job Context Specific
   

  

 Coordination with R\&D, Commercial \& Quality
   

  

* Coordinate with the R\&D team to align pilot\-line trial plans and changeover schedules with new chemistry/product development roadmaps, translating technical requirements into achievable pilot\-line builds.
* Coordinate with the Commercial team to understand customer and sample requirements, prioritize pilot\-line build sequencing accordingly, and ensure timely delivery of trial cells/samples against commitments.


 Knowledge Specific
   

  

 B.E in (Mechanical/Electrical /Chemical), Six Sigma Certified / 10–15\+ years leading manufacturing/pilot\-line operations in Li\-ion cell, EV battery pack, or solar cell manufacturing, with NPI, process validation, or multi\-chemistry changeover exposure. Strong process knowledge across electrode/mixing\-coating, cutting/stacking, cell assembly, welding, formation \& aging, and vision inspection, including how process parameters shift across chemistries. Skilled in exception handling, NG/CAPA management, and problem\-solving tools (8D, Six Sigma, 7 QC, 5\-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, DOE). Working knowledge of IATF 16949, SAP/ERP, and MES for shop\-floor data and compliance. Proven cross\-functional coordination with R\&D, Commercial, and Quality to translate production needs into a pilot\-line plan

title: Store Director
description:
**Company Description** 
 Smiling Rocks is a purpose\-driven fine jewelry brand founded to bring smiles and contribute to a better, brighter world. The company focuses on sustainability, responsible labor, and responsible sourcing as core brand values. Smiling Rocks offers origin\-guaranteed, eco\-friendly, and socially conscious laboratory\-grown diamonds and diamond jewelry. Giving back is a key priority, with a portion of each purchase donated to charity organizations chosen by customers. The brand believes in a collaborative effort to create a more caring world with improved values and global peace.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Store Director role at Smiling Rocks is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Ahmedabad. The Store Director will oversee daily store operations, including staff supervision, visual merchandising, inventory management, and adherence to brand standards. This role is responsible for driving sales performance, setting targets, and monitoring key metrics to ensure the store meets revenue and customer satisfaction goals. The Store Director will lead and coach the store team, provide ongoing training, and foster an inclusive, service\-oriented environment aligned with the brand’s mission and values. Additional responsibilities include handling customer escalations, coordinating with corporate teams on promotions and product assortments, and ensuring compliance with operational and ethical guidelines.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong store management and retail operations skills, with experience overseeing daily activities and leading store teams.
* Background in commerce or business, with understanding of retail metrics, budgeting, and reporting.
* Proven sales skills, including target setting, performance tracking, and implementing strategies to increase revenue.
* Excellent customer service and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to manage complex or sensitive customer interactions.
* Experience in staff training, coaching, and performance development in a retail or customer\-facing environment.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams.
* Ability to work on\-site in Ahmedabad, including weekends and peak retail hours as needed.
* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Retail Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
* Experience in jewelry, luxury retail, or sustainable/ethical brands is an advantage.
* Demonstrated commitment to ethical practices, sustainability, and community impact aligned with Smiling Rocks’ values.

title: Sr. Manager, Professional Services
description:
**A career that’s the whole package!**
 At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.
   

  

**Conga** 
 lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.
   

  

**Job Title** 
 : Senior Manager, PS
   

  

**Locations** 
 : Ahmedabad
   

  

**Reports to** 
 : Regional Vice President, Professional Services
   

  

**A career that’s the whole package!**
 At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate, support for growth through individual and team development, and an environment where all voices can be heard.
   

  

**Conga** 
 crushes complexity within an increasingly complex world. With our revenue lifecycle management solution, we transform your unique complexities for order configuration, execution, fulfillment, and contract renewal processes with a single critical insights data model that adapts to ever\-changing business requirements and aligns the understanding and efforts of every team.
   

  

**Our mission** 
 : Empower customers to deliver transformational revenue growth by aligning teams, processes, and technology to maximize customer lifetime value.
   

  

 Our approach is grounded in the Conga Way, a framework for what we stand for and everything we do as an organization — from hiring to decision making and product development. Developed with direct input from our colleagues, the Conga Way is the foundation for our culture.
   

  

**A quick snapshot** 
**…**
 A Senior Manager will build and manage an effective team from offshore centre. It includes hiring, training, coaching, retaining, and measuring the effectiveness of a high\-performing PS delivery team. Be a problem solver and a guide, coach, mentor, and a strong communicator.
   

  

**Why it’s a big deal…**
 The Senior Manager will play a key role in building a strong and effective team who will deal with different situations while working on the projects.
   

  

**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**Related experience.** 
 Must have 15\+ years of experience in the IT industry, with strong experience in building and managing high\-performing teams. Should have solid experience coordinating with global and offshore teams, along with full lifecycle enterprise software implementation experience. Experience working with Conga products such as CPQ and CLM, or with any CRM or SaaS platform, will be a strong added advantage.
   

  

**Strong communication and interpersonal skills.** 
 You’re not just comfortable engaging in collaborative discussions, but initiating them, too. You are skilled at reading and adapting to different communication styles, and when you speak you are clear and concise. Your strong listening skills foster connection with our customers and stakeholders and allow you to accurately gather the right information so you can resolve issues in the most effective way.
   

  

**Natural collaborator.** 
 You work effectively across functions — with Delivery Teams, Practice Directors, Regional Heads and customer stakeholders — to drive successful project outcomes. You are proficient with Agile and have a collaborative, cross\-functional approach to delivering great solutions. You are comfortable working across multiple teams and championing best practices. You constantly seek opinions and solicit feedback to create the best work possible. You don’t know any other way, It’s a team effort and you completely appreciate that.
   

  

**People leadership and development.** 
 You take genuine ownership of your team — hiring, coaching, mentoring, and retaining top talent. You invest in each individual’s career growth and skill expansion, building clear development paths and a culture where people do their best work and want to stay.
   

  

**Driving initiatives and an AI\-first mindset.** 
 You lead organizational initiatives that raise the bar for delivery, and you champion AI\-driven ways of working to improve efficiency, quality, and customer outcomes. You proactively identify opportunities to innovate and bring your team along with you.
   

  

**Subject matter expertise.** 
 You serve as a trusted subject matter expert for Conga’s enterprise customers, understanding their business challenges and how our solutions solve them. You bring credibility to customer conversations and help your team navigate complex enterprise implementations.
   

  

**Education.** 
 A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field is highly preferred.
   

  

**Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…**
**Passion** 
 . We know it when we see it. Passion is not about saying how much you love what you do in your most excited voice. Passion is revealed in your truest self. It’s about what you’ve accomplished; how you want to grow; the ideas you have; your philosophies. It’s demonstrating through your words and your actions that you truly believe in what you do \-\- and where you work. That it matters to you. And that’s pretty cool.
   

  

**Initiative** 
 . You don’t wait around for things to happen or for your manager to tell you what to do. You’re not only proactive about completing your own work, but when you sense the need to introduce a project that will benefit the team or the organization \-\- even if it’s outside your scope of work \-\- you put a proposal together, talk to the team about it, and
 *own it* 
 . And that also goes back to having an entrepreneurial spirt
   

  

**Did we pique your interest?**
 If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!
   

  

**Preferred Resume Format**
 We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.
   

  

**Don’t meet every requirement for the role?** 


 Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. title: US Tax Manager
description:
MYCPE ONE is building a modern, technology\-enabled accounting firm serving small and mid\-sized businesses across the United States. Our model combines experienced US client\-facing professionals with a highly skilled global delivery team to provide accounting, tax, audit, advisory, and CFO services.
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced
 **Business Tax Delivery Lead** 
 to lead the execution and delivery of US business tax engagements from our India\-based global delivery team.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Business Tax Delivery Lead will be based in India and will serve as the operational and execution leader for MYCPE ONE's offshore Business Tax delivery team, supporting US business tax compliance and planning engagements end to end. This individual will oversee day\-to\-day engagement execution, manage the offshore business tax team, ensure technical quality and timely delivery, and work in close coordination with the US\-based Onshore Tax Engagement Lead.
 



 This is a full\-time, salaried leadership position within MYCPE ONE's global delivery organization. It does not carry responsibility for client acquisition or closing new CPA firm relationships. The focus is on operational excellence, execution, and delivery, working within engagements that the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead has already secured and scoped.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Delivery Leadership** 



* Lead the offshore Business Tax delivery team supporting US\-based clients and CPA firms.
* Own end\-to\-end execution of assigned business tax compliance and planning engagements.
* Ensure returns and workpapers are staffed, scheduled, and delivered on time, particularly around federal and state filing deadlines and extension cycles.
* Implement and maintain SOPs, review checklists, and delivery workflows for business tax engagements.



  





**Engagement Execution and Client Servicing** 



* Serve as a direct point of contact for end clients on day\-to\-day business tax matters.
* Coordinate preparation of corporate (Form 1120\), S\-corporation (Form 1120\-S), and partnership (Form 1065\) returns, including multi\-state filings.
* Respond to client requests for information and resolve routine client queries, including estimated payments and notice\-related questions.
* Keep clients and the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead informed of engagement status and open items.



  





**Technical Review and Quality** 



* Review business tax returns, supporting workpapers, and calculations prepared by the offshore team.
* Apply and enforce IRS regulations, business tax compliance requirements, and firm methodology across engagements.
* Identify and resolve technical issues at the engagement level, escalating complex business tax planning, entity structuring, or controversy matters to the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead.
* Support quality control reviews and consistency of review standards across the business tax team.



  





**Onshore Coordination** 



* Work closely with the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead on engagement planning and scoping handed off from the US side.
* Provide regular status updates, capacity forecasts, and escalation of risks or delays, particularly during peak filing season.
* Align offshore execution with onshore expectations on quality, timelines, and client communication standards.



  





**Team Management and Operations** 



* Manage, mentor, and develop offshore tax managers, seniors, and preparers focused on business tax.
* Plan resource allocation and workload distribution across engagements, especially during tax season peaks.
* Monitor engagement metrics such as turnaround time, review points, and rework.
* Drive process improvements and standardization across the business tax delivery team.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, and training of offshore business tax staff.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Required** 



* CPA qualification (active US CPA license preferred) or Enrolled Agent (EA) credential; candidates with a completed CPA and strong US business tax experience will also be considered.
* Active PTIN (Preparer Tax Identification Number) in good standing with the IRS.
* 12\+ years of experience in US business tax compliance, with a primary focus on corporate, S\-corporation, and partnership return preparation and review.
* Experience working within an offshore or global delivery team serving US CPA firms or US clients directly.
* Demonstrated experience managing execution and delivery of business tax engagements, not limited to preparation or review of individual returns.
* Experience serving as a point of contact for end clients on business tax matters.
* Experience working in close coordination with an onshore or US\-based engagement lead or partner.
* Strong understanding of:
* Corporate, S\-corporation, and partnership tax compliance, including multi\-state filings
* Business tax planning, including entity structuring considerations
* K\-1 preparation and pass\-through reporting
* IRS notices, correspondence, and basic resolution processes
* Experience supervising and developing business tax teams.



  





**Preferred** 



* Experience in a role dedicated to delivery and operations rather than business development.
* Experience with outsourced or offshored business tax compliance services.
* Experience with multi\-entity or consolidated business tax structures.
* Experience with international information reporting related to US business tax filings.
* Experience with technology\-enabled business tax preparation and workflow tools.



  





**Technical Skills** 




 Experience with one or more of the following:
 


* Thomson Reuters (UltraTax)
* CCH Axcess / ProSystem fx Tax
* Drake
* Lacerte
* Intuit ProConnect



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Within the first year, the Business Tax Delivery Lead will:
 


* Establish a reliable, well\-run offshore delivery model for US business tax engagements.
* Consistently meet filing deadlines and quality benchmarks, including through peak tax season.
* Build a strong, capable offshore business tax team.
* Operate as a trusted operational counterpart to the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead.
* Maintain high client satisfaction on execution and responsiveness.
* Drive measurable improvements in delivery efficiency and process consistency.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands\-on business tax professional based in India who has spent their career executing and managing US business tax engagements within an offshore or global delivery environment. They are comfortable working directly with US end clients on delivery matters, thrive in a structured operational role, and are motivated by running a high\-quality, efficient delivery engine rather than by business development or practice ownership.

title: Assistant Manager – Logistics & Customer Service
description:
**Scicore Nutra Private Limited (wholly owned subsidiary of Glanbia Nutritionals (Ireland)) is a state\-of\-the\-art facility, located in Sanand Gujarat, dedicated to producing high\-quality nutrition products that are safe, effective, and meet the highest standards of quality. Our team of experts is committed to ensuring that every product we manufacture is produced with the utmost care and attention to detail.** 




  





**At our manufacturing unit, we use only the best raw materials and employ advanced manufacturing processes to ensure that our products are of the highest quality. We also adhere to strict quality control measures to ensure that every product meets our rigorous standards. This starts with doing a rigorous vendor qualification as well as testing of all raw materials supplied by these vendors for every batch. We do in\-house stability studies to make sure our products last the full shelf life and give the best results to our customers.** 




  





**Our goal is to provide our customers with nutraceutical products that promote health and wellness, and we are committed to using science\-backed ingredients and formulations to achieve this goal. We are also committed to continuous innovation and improvement and are always looking for new ways to enhance our products and processes.** 




  





**Role will be based at E\-279, GIDC, Nr. Rasulpura Village, II, Bol, Sanand, Gujarat 382170, India** 




**6 Day work week** 




  





**Benefits Provided:** 



* Free Air\-Conditioned Transportation to the Factory
* Paid Leave
* Tea/Coffee \& Canteen Facility
* Accident Insurance
* Provision for Bonus \& Gratuity
* Training programs for professional advancement
* Progressive work environments conducive to personal and professional growth



  





**Job Summary:** 




 The Assistant Manager – Logistics \& Customer Service will own secondary logistics execution and customer service operations for Glanbia’s distribution network, managing order fulfilment from the plant to key trade customers. The role will be the primary interface between Glanbia and its trade partners on all logistics and service matters, driving Order Fill Rate, OTIF, and TAT performance while building long\-term customer relationships and service excellence.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Own the order\-to\-dispatch cycle for all Glanbia India trade customers – receive purchase orders, validate against available stock in coordination with the supply planner, coordinate dispatch plans with the Plant Logistics Manager, and ensure OTIF delivery to all customers and Inter DC supplies.
* Manage secondary logistics from the Ahmedabad / Sanand DC to trade customers – plan truck requirements, coordinate with approved transporters, track shipments to proof of delivery (POD), and resolve transit exceptions.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between Glanbia and its trade customers on all logistics and service matters – manage order confirmations, dispatch notifications, delivery lead time communication, short\-shipment resolutions, and escalation handling.
* Handle customer claims, returns, and damaged goods – investigate root causes in coordination with quality and logistics teams, initiate credit / replacement processes, and resolve all cases within defined TAT SLAs
* Maintain and publish the weekly dispatch plan and customer\-wise stock allocation in coordination with the supply planner; flag allocation constraints proactively and escalate supply risks to commercial and supply chain leadership.
* Manage transporter SLAs for secondary routes – monitor on\-time delivery performance, transit damage incidence, and POD submission compliance; conduct quarterly transporter performance reviews and recommend changes as required.
* Track and report Order Fill Rate (OFR), OTIF (secondary), claims TAT, and DC utilization KPIs on a monthly basis to Glanbia supply chain and commercial leadership.
* Identify and implement process improvements in order management, dispatch coordination, customer communication, and claims workflows – continually working to reduce lead time, eliminate errors, and enhance the customer experience.



  





**Education \& Experience:** 



* Graduate with minimum 5 – 7 years of experience in logistics operations, customer service, or trade marketing coordination, preferably in FMCG, nutraceuticals, or consumer goods distribution.
* Management qualification in Supply Chain, Logistics, Marketing, or Business Management preferred.
* Hands\-on experience managing distributor and modern trade customer relationships and secondary logistics operations in the India market.
* Proficiency in SAP \& SAP B1 modules and TMS (transport management systems).



  





**Required Skills:** 



* Strong end\-to\-end understanding of order management, secondary logistics, trade customer service, and distribution operations.
* Acute understanding of the linkage between supply availability, dispatch planning, transporter management, and customer delivery performance.
* Ability to work effectively with stakeholders across commercial, supply planning, logistics, quality, and finance teams, as well as external trade customers and 3PL partners.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills – able to manage customer expectations diplomatically, resolve conflicts under time pressure, and represent Glanbia professionally across all customer interactions.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability – able to lead KPI reviews, conduct root\-cause analysis on service failures, and implement corrective actions swiftly.
* Fluency in English and Hindi mandatory; Gujarati an advantage for customer communication across the Ahmedabad.
* High level of integrity, ownership, dependability, and customer orientation.

title: Manager – CFM (Contamination Free Manufacturing)
description:

 Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
 



 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.

1. Responsible for cleanroom buy\-off and sustaining activities to ensure fab cleanliness, driving yield improvement and contamination control (Particles, AMPC, VOC/TOC).
2. Develop and execute fab\-wide
 **contamination control strategy** 
 (particles, metals, organics, ionic contamination, and AMC/molecular contamination).
3. Develop and maintain automated CFM data monitoring and alert systems (hardware/software) to enable early issue detection.
4. Define, track, and improve contamination KPIs (defectivity, adders, SPC alarms, excursions).

8. Collaborate cross\-functionally with

10. Mentor more Engineers as required
11. Travel, as necessary
12. Presentation to internal teams and senior executives
13. Drive cross\-functional yield improvement projects and DOEs
14. Lead FA and convert findings into corrective/preventive actions



**Essential Attributes** 



* Ability to manage, mentor, and lead a team of highly motivated professionals.
* Able to work independently, self\-motivated with a strong drive to win.
* Team player with the ability to work across diverse cross\-functional teams spread across the world.
* Leadership skills to influence all levels of the organization.

* An avid learner, you approach challenges with curiosity and resilience, seeking data to help build understanding.
* You’re collaborative, building relationships, humbly offering support and openly welcoming approaches.
* Innovative and creative, you proactively explore new ideas and adapt quickly to change.



**Qualifications** 



1. M.S in Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, M.Tech in Chemical or equivalent
2. Strong understanding of
 **analytical techniques** 
 (Chromatography, SEM, ICP\-MS, etc).
3. Deep understanding of Semiconductor wafer Fabrication
4. Proven track record in yield improvement on new and mature technologies
5. Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and achieve project completion within timeline and cost targets
6. Ability to work across different cultures and geographies
7. Good team player
8. Innovation and competitive mindset



**Desired Experience Level** 



1. 7\+ years experience in the semiconductor industry
2. Proven track record of successfully developing new technologies into high volume production
3. Proven problem solving skills using design of experiments and analytical tools

* Partner with the 3PL warehouse partner and the logistics team to optimize pallet utilization, container loads (FCL), and transportation efficiency across the India network.
* Support annual budget and supply planning processes – provide volume, RM / PM cost, and inventory investment inputs to the Glanbia India finance and leadership teams.

* Advanced Excel modelling skills mandatory; Power BI for KPI dashboard development preferred.

* Sound knowledge of BOM structures, MRP / MPS logic, inventory costing, and replenishment planning (reorder point, min\-max, safety stock optimization).
* Ability to run structured S\&OP processes and present supply risk and opportunity analysis to senior commercial and operations leadership.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills – ability to work effectively with commercial, manufacturing, logistics, quality, procurement, and finance teams.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority and manage well under uncertainty and time pressure.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, with a data\-driven approach to supply decisions and a proactive bias toward risk identification and escalation.
* High level of integrity, ownership, dependability, and results orientation.

title: Premier Service manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**Business Descriptor**
 Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
   

  

**Job Introduction**
 The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long\-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer\-facing, primarily servicing walk\-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client\-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities**
* Provide high\-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross\-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross\-selling opportunities.


**Education Qualifications / Certifications And Requirements**
* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.


**Other Requirements (Knowledge And Experience)**
* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well\-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.

*This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible.*

**Introduction**
 We are further strengthening our Inventory Management organization. Therefore, we are seeking a
 **Manager, Global Manufacturing Inventories** 
 to join us within the Consumables (CNS) Business Area.
 **You will be responsible for increasing our maturity in inventory management for raw materials, rubber compound and work\-in\-process.** 
 You will develop, implement and maintain our different levels of guidelines and metrics. An essential part of this role is to drive the development and implementation of global planning and inventory governance for rubber compound manufacturing.
   

  

 The role can be located in any of our main CNS manufacturing locations. While we support hybrid ways of working, we highly value in\-person collaboration and relationship building. Therefore, regular presence at the local office is expected.
   

  

**Team you belong to**
 You will join a team of professionals who are passionate about taking the Consumables business area to the next level and delivering the business results by working closely with colleagues around the world and ensuring state of world supply chain network. We are further developing our rather new organization and our ways of working and looking for the best candidate to join us on this journey.
   

  

 We work closely with both the full Consumables business area and all the market areas. Our team culture is all about driving for results, creating value for Metso and our customers and succeeding together. You will report to the Director, Inventory Management.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own and facilitate inventory management roadmap for raw materials, rubber compound and work\-in\-progress in factories and foundries
* Drive inventory management harmonization and development for all life\-cycle phases of materials and products (define policies, processes, standards, metrics and KPIs)

* Manage in\-process product quality in coordination with vendors and contract manufacturers to meet defined quality specifications
* Communicate with customers and vendors to investigate and resolve quality review\-related issues in a timely manner
