title: Calibration Laboratory Head
description:
Job Title: Calibration Laboratory Head
 



 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



 Company: Oizom Instruments Pvt. Ltd.
 



  





**About Oizom:** 




 Oizom is a leading environmental monitoring solutions company, building innovative sensor\-based platforms to measure, analyze, and visualize environmental data. Our solutions help governments, industries, and researchers make data\-driven decisions for cleaner and healthier environments.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are hiring a Calibration Laboratory Head to lead the technical direction and quality oversight of our calibration laboratory for gas, dust, and meteorological instruments. This role involves defining calibration processes, developing SOPs, planning setups for new parameters and capabilities, and driving measurement accuracy improvement through structured testing.
 



  





**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs):** 




 ● Develop and maintain calibration SOPs, work instructions, and technical documentation across gas, dust, and meteorological parameters
 



 ● Plan and define calibration setups for new parameters, instrument types, or measurement ranges — providing technical specifications, workflow design, and environmental requirements
 



 ● Design and supervise testing experiments to identify and reduce sources of measurement error — linearity, drift, cross\-sensitivity, and environmental influence studies
 



 ● Set calibration quality standards, monitor KPIs, and drive continuous improvement
 



 ● Prepare and maintain measurement uncertainty budgets and ensure traceability to national/international standards
 



 ● Build and maintain quality documentation and processes aligned to ISO/IEC 17025 standards
 



 ● Provide technical direction, training, and mentorship to the team.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




 ● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Instrumentation, Environmental Engineering, Applied Physics, Atmospheric Science, Metrology, or a related field
 



 ● Minimum 4 years of hands\-on experience in a calibration or testing laboratory environment, with a total professional experience of 6\+ years preferred.
 



 ● Strong understanding of measurement uncertainty estimation and GUM methodology
 



 ● Experience with gas analyzers, dust/particulate monitors, or meteorological sensors
 



 ● Demonstrated ability to write SOPs, design calibration workflows, and build technical documentation ● Proven ability to lead and coordinate with technical teams
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 ● Experience with NABL or ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation processes
 



 ● ISO/IEC 17025 Internal Auditor or Lead Assessor certification
 



 ● Experience in designing testing experiments, method validation, or accuracy improvement initiatives ● Familiarity with air quality regulatory standards and calibration protocols
 



 ● Proficiency with data analysis tools and statistical methods

title: Assistant General Manager, Manufacturing
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
* Technical Leadership \& Process Optimization
* Upstream Strategy: Lead the design, optimization, and troubleshooting of Solid\-Phase Peptide Synthesis (SPPS) protocols, including difficult sequences and modification chemistry.
* Downstream Scaling: Direct the scaling up of Preparative HPLC and RP\-HPLC purification methods from analytical to pilot/production scale.
* Troubleshooting: Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) to resolve complex synthesis failures, poor solubility issues, and challenging impurity profiles.
* Tech Transfer: Oversee the seamless transfer of peptide processes from the R\&D stage to validation and commercial production batches.
* Operations \& Team Management
* Resource Allocation: Manage a team 22 members of engineers/scientists, assigning daily synthesis, purification, and lyophilization tasks.
* Project Timelines: Ensure projects meet strict delivery schedules while optimizing raw material consumption (resins, protected amino acids, solvents).
* Equipment Oversight: Oversee the calibration, maintenance, and qualification of automated synthesizers, Prep\-HPLC systems, and lyophilizers.
* Data Integrity: Review and sign off on chromatograms, analytical data, Master Batch Records (MBRs), and final batch release reports.
* Compliance Lead: Ensure the laboratory strictly adheres to GLP/GMP guidelines, data integrity standards, and safety regulations.
* SOP Authoring: Author, update, and approve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), deviation reports, and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).


**Qualifications**
**Candidate Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Education: B.Tech / M.Tech in Biotechnology or Chemical Engineering OR M.Sc. / Ph.D. in Organic, Analytical, or Biochemistry.
* Experience: 15 to 18\+ years of core industrial experience in peptide chemistry, with at least 2\+ years in a supervisory or team\-leading role.
* Technical Mastery: Deep, provable expertise spanning both upstream chain\-building (cleavage, coupling) and downstream isolation (salt\-exchange, TFF, freeze\-drying).
* Software Literacy: High proficiency in chromatography data software (e.g., Empower, Chromeleon) and data analysis tools.
* Soft Skills: Strong project management, clear cross\-functional communication, and a proven track record of mentoring junior scientists.

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
**Department:** 
 Engineering
   

  

**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad/GiftCity
   

  

**Description**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
   

  

 This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**
**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


**Benefits**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work\-Life Support \& Resources:
+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited** 
 , a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among
 **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work** 
 , combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
 **Employer of Choice** 
 is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end\-to\-end mid\-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To manage mid\-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Hub Operations Management**
* Lead day\-to\-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.


**Mid Mile Network Operations**
* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time\-definite shipments across the network.


**Network Coordination \& Exception Management**
* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.

title: Production Manager
description:
**About Company:** 




 Vimson Derma is a contract manufacturer of cosmetic and medicated products based in Ahmedabad. With over 45 years of experience in cosmetics and dermatology, Vimson Derma is a trusted name in the industry. The company is GMP, GLP, and ISO 9001:2015 certified, ensuring the highest quality standards. Vimson Derma manufactures a wide range of products including dusting powders, talcum powders, shampoo, conditioner, cream, gel, lotions, oil, soaps, sunscreen, serums and more. With a strong client base, Vimson Derma works with over 200 companies across India.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 To lead and oversee the complete production operations of both the Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic manufacturing plants by ensuring products are manufactured safely, efficiently, and in compliance with quality and regulatory standards. The Production Head will be responsible for production planning, manpower management, process optimization, capacity utilization, and achieving production targets through effective leadership of Production Supervisors and cross\-functional coordination.  
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 




 1\. Production Operations Management  
 



 Lead and oversee daily production activities for both Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic manufacturing plants.  
 



 Ensure production schedules are executed efficiently while meeting quality, cost, and delivery objectives.  
 



 Allocate resources, manpower, and equipment to maximize productivity and plant utilization.  
 



 Monitor production output, efficiency, and adherence to production plans.  
 



  





 2\. Leadership \& Team Management 
 



 Lead, mentor, and develop Production Supervisors and production teams across both plants.  
 



 Define production targets and monitor team performance through regular reviews.  
 



 Build a culture of accountability, discipline, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.  
 



 Ensure adequate manpower planning and succession planning for production functions.  
 



  





 3\. Production Planning \& Coordination 
 



 Coordinate with PPC, Stores, Purchase, QA, QC, Warehouse, Maintenance, and Dispatch to ensure uninterrupted production.  
 



 Review daily production plans and prioritize manufacturing based on business requirements.
 



 Ensure timely availability of raw materials, packing materials, machinery, and manpower.  
 



  





 4\. Process Improvement \& Productivity 
 



 Identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce manufacturing cycle time, and optimize resource utilization.  
 



 Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.  
 



 Monitor production KPIs and drive corrective actions for performance improvement.  
 



  





 5\. Quality \& Compliance 
 



 Ensure all manufacturing activities comply with GMP, SOPs, Batch Manufacturing 
 



 Records (BMR), and applicable regulatory requirements.  
 



 Support QA and QC in investigations related to deviations, non\-conformances, and CAPA implementation.  
 



 Ensure production documentation is complete, accurate, and audit\-ready.  
 



 Prepare both plants for customer audits and future WHO\-GMP certification.  
 



  





 6\. Operational Excellence 
 



 Monitor Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), production efficiency, and manufacturing losses.  
 



 Reduce production downtime through effective coordination with Engineering and Maintenance teams.  
 



 Minimize product rejections, rework, wastage, and process deviations.  
 



 Drive continuous improvement projects to enhance manufacturing performance.  
 



  





 7\. Safety \& Compliance 
 



 Ensure adherence to EHS, GMP, and workplace safety practices across both plants.  
 



 Promote safe handling of materials, equipment, and manufacturing processes.  
 



 Ensure production personnel comply with hygiene and safety requirements.  
 



 8\. Reporting \& Performance Monitoring 
 



 Review daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.  
 



 Monitor production KPIs, capacity utilization, manpower efficiency, and manufacturing costs.  
 



 Present operational performance and improvement initiatives to senior management. 
 



  





**Required qualification and skills:** 




 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Chemical Engineering, Industrial 
 



 Engineering, Cosmetic Science, or a related field.  
 



 10–15 years of production experience in Pharmaceuticals, Cosmetics, FMCG, or regulated manufacturing industries.  
 



 Minimum 5 years of experience in a production leadership role managing multiple production lines or manufacturing units.  
 



 Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical and cosmetic manufacturing processes.  
 



 Experience with GMP, WHO\-GMP, ISO standards, documentation, and regulatory compliance.  
 



 Knowledge of production planning, capacity management, batch manufacturing, and process optimization.  
 



 Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.  
 



 Strong leadership, people management, communication, and decision\-making skills.  
 



 Proficiency in ERP systems, MS Office, and manufacturing reporting tools. 
 



  





**Working Days** 
 : 6 days 
 



  





**Manufacturing Location:** 
 816/3 Kothari Industrial Estate, Opp Khodal Lodge, Santej, Kalol, Gujarat 382721\.

**About The Role**
 Responsible for the
 **end\-to\-end management of plant stores, warehouse, inventory, material movement and logistics operations** 
 . The role will ensure timely material receipt, storage, issue, internal movement and dispatch while maintaining high inventory accuracy, proper documentation, ERP discipline and cost\-effective logistics operations.

 **right material, in the right quantity, at the right location, with the right documentation and at the right time** 
 .
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Stores \& Warehouse Management: Manage day\-to\-day plant stores and warehouse operations, including receiving, unloading, inspection coordination, put\-away, bin management, storage, space utilization, 5S and safety.

title: BIM Lead / VP – Production
description:
BIM Lead / VP – Production
 



  





**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat — 100% In\-Office (Candidates from anywhere in India welcome to apply; relocation to Ahmedabad required)
 **Experience:** 
 8\+ Years (Multi\-Discipline BIM Production \& Team Leadership)
 **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| Minimum 2\.5\-Year Service Commitment (Employment Bond \+ Strict NDA applicable)
 **Reports To:** 
 Founder / CEO
 



  





 About Us
 



  





**BIM Expert Studio** 
 is a fast\-growing BIM and CAD outsourcing company based in Ahmedabad, India, delivering Architecture, Structural, MEPF, and Scan\-to\-BIM production services to Architecture, Engineering \& Construction (AEC) firms, building surveyors, and MEPF/General Contractors across the United States. We work across multiple project types and disciplines with a production team built to scale.
 



 We're looking for a hands\-on BIM Lead / VP – Production to own end\-to\-end technical delivery, build and lead our modeling team, and become the technical backbone of the company as we scale production capacity.
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role — not a purely managerial one. You will be the final technical authority across every discipline we serve (Architecture, Structural, MEPF, Scan\-to\-BIM), responsible for making sure any project that comes in from a US client — regardless of discipline or project type — can be delivered correctly, on time, and to US AEC documentation standards. You will also build out the production bench itself: hiring, training, and developing modelers and drafters as the team scales.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




1. Own end\-to\-end technical delivery across all disciplines — Architecture, Structural, MEPF, and Scan\-to\-BIM — for every incoming client project, regardless of discipline or project type.
2. Review incoming project scopes from US clients and determine discipline, LOD, staffing, and timeline requirements.
3. Set up and enforce BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), modeling standards, and QA/QC checkpoints for every project.
4. Directly model, troubleshoot, or unblock any discipline when the team hits a technical wall — you should be able to open any file and solve the problem yourself.
5. Hire, onboard, and train BIM modelers and drafters across disciplines as the team scales; build internal training/SOP material for new hires.
6. Allocate resources and manage capacity planning across multiple concurrent projects and deadlines.
7. Run multi\-discipline coordination and clash detection reviews before deliverables go out.
8. Act as the primary technical point of contact for US clients on project\-specific queries, scope clarifications, and escalations.
9. Standardize templates, families, and content libraries across disciplines to improve production speed and consistency.
10. Mentor and develop team leads under you so the production team can eventually run with less day\-to\-day involvement from you.
11. Track and report production KPIs (turnaround time, rework rate, capacity utilization) to leadership.
12. Maintain strict confidentiality of client data, drawings, and business information at all times.



  





 Technical Skills Required
 



  





 1\. Architectural BIM
 



  




1. Full concept\-to\-Construction Documents (CD) production: floor plans, elevations, sections, RCPs, schedules, and detailing
2. Experience across multiple project types — residential (multi\-family/single\-family), commercial, hospitality, healthcare, education, and industrial
3. Revit family creation and library management across LOD 100–500
4. Working knowledge of US code frameworks (IBC, ADA) as they apply to documentation accuracy
5. Renovation, addition, and adaptive\-reuse modeling from existing/as\-built conditions
6. Interior architecture and tenant improvement (TI) documentation



  





 2\. Structural BIM
 



  




1. Steel, concrete, wood\-frame, and light\-gauge structural modeling
2. Rebar detailing and structural shop drawing coordination
3. Framing plans, connections, and structural detailing
4. Translating structural engineers' design intent and calculations into accurate models
5. Foundation, podium, and structural steel detailing
6. Structural clash resolution against architectural and MEPF models



  





 3\. MEPF (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection)
 



  




1. HVAC ductwork, piping, and equipment modeling
2. Electrical power, lighting, low\-voltage systems, and panel schedule modeling
3. Plumbing supply, waste, and vent system modeling
4. Fire protection and sprinkler system layout and modeling
5. Multi\-system MEPF coordination for clash\-free installation
6. Spool and fabrication drawing generation to support prefabrication workflows



  





 4\. Scan\-to\-BIM / Reality Capture
 



  




1. Point cloud registration and cleanup (Recap, Cyclone, or equivalent)
2. As\-built modeling directly from point cloud/laser scan data
3. Existing conditions documentation for renovation and retrofit projects
4. Accuracy validation and QA of scan\-derived models against source data
5. Integrating scan\-based models into ongoing design/coordination workflows



  





 5\. Software \& Platform Proficiency
 



  




1. Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP)
2. AutoCAD / AutoCAD MEP
3. Navisworks Manage (clash detection and 4D sequencing)
4. Autodesk Recap / Recap Pro (point cloud processing)
5. BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud
6. Civil 3D (added advantage)
7. Dynamo or other BIM automation/scripting tools (added advantage)
8. MS Project and Excel for scheduling and resource tracking



  





 6\. Standards, Process \& Coordination
 



  




1. BIM Execution Plan (BEP) development and enforcement
2. LOD (Level of Development) specification, assignment, and QA
3. Familiarity with US AEC documentation standards (AIA/NCS conventions)
4. Working exposure to ISO 19650 principles
5. Multi\-discipline clash detection and resolution workflows
6. Standardizing templates and content libraries across projects and disciplines



  





 7\. Leadership \& Team Management
 



  




1. Hiring, onboarding, and training BIM modelers and drafters
2. Resource allocation and capacity planning across concurrent projects
3. Production quality control and deadline/SLA management
4. Direct client\-facing communication with US\-based AEC clients
5. Mentoring team leads and building internal training material/SOPs
6. Managing any vendor or subcontracted production resources, if applicable



  





 Requirements
 



  




* Minimum 8 years of hands\-on BIM/CAD production experience, with demonstrated exposure across
 **at least three** 
 of the four core disciplines (Architecture, Structural, MEPF, Scan\-to\-BIM)
* Prior experience leading or building a production team (hiring, training, and managing modelers/drafters)
* Experience working with or delivering to US\-based AEC clients strongly preferred
* Strong written and verbal English communication for direct client interaction
* Based in or willing to relocate to Ahmedabad for a 100% in\-office role
* Willing to commit to a minimum 2\.5\-year tenure, backed by an employment bond and a strict NDA (given direct exposure to client data and production processes)



  





 What We Offer
 



  




* A senior leadership role shaping production strategy at a company built for scale
* Direct, ongoing exposure to the US AEC market across a wide range of disciplines and project types
* Competitive fixed compensation plus performance\-linked incentives
* A clear growth path into senior/company leadership as the team and client base expand
* **To Apply:** 
 send you applications on Mike@mazinfotech.com

title: Operations Manager
description:

 Eunoia Designtech, founded in 2016 and based in Ahmedabad, is a design consultancy focused on transforming bold ideas into practical, high\-impact solutions. The team combines mechanical design, web development, graphic design, branding, printing, and digital marketing to deliver creative work aligned with clear business goals. By deeply understanding each brand’s objectives and audience, Eunoia Designtech creates campaigns and solutions that perform strategically and maximize ROI. The company has partnered with over 150 clients across diverse industries such as FMCG, textiles, real estate, architecture, cosmetics, retail, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, and finance. Integrating technology, creativity, and strategy, Eunoia Designtech’s promise is simple: if you can think it, they can develop it.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Operations Manager will oversee daily operations across design, development, and marketing projects to ensure smooth workflows and timely delivery. This full\-time, on\-site role in Ahmedabad involves coordinating cross\-functional teams, optimizing processes, managing resource allocation, and monitoring project progress against timelines and quality standards. The Operations Manager will implement and refine operational policies, maintain documentation, and use data to identify opportunities for efficiency and performance improvement. The role includes collaborating with leadership on planning, budgeting, and capacity management, as well as supporting client servicing teams to meet project requirements and resolve operational issues. The Operations Manager will also help nurture a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and effective communication within the organization.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a focus on clear, structured reporting and stakeholder updates.
* Proficiency in using productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., project management platforms, spreadsheets, documentation tools).
* Demonstrated experience in a managerial or supervisory role, preferably within a creative, tech, or consulting organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field; advanced qualifications are a plus.
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
